required_presentation_changes.prior: Aircraft design approval, production approval, pilot qualification and an operator's authority are distinct objects. The FAA powered-lift rule creates operating and certification pathways within its scope; it does not issue every approval needed by a particular service. Local facilities, airspace procedures and emergency arrangements introduce additional responsibilities. The retained FAA powered-lift rule profile describes pilot and instructor certification and operating pathways; it does not itself grant an aircraft type certificate, operator certificate, route authority or vertiport approval. Local facilities, airspace procedures and emergency arrangements have additional responsibilities. A clear project account should name the relevant authority and exact instrument, including its conditions. This preserves the rule's stated scope without treating one milestone as the entire operating chain or claiming a new check of current permissions.

required_presentation_changes.prior: NIST standards and federal migration guidance make cryptographic change more concrete, but a standard does not replace cryptography in an operating system. Institutions need to identify where vulnerable algorithms are used, which information needs long protection and which suppliers control implementation. Procurement, interoperability testing, cutover and retirement then become distinct milestones. The report should keep those records tied to named systems and versions. A plan can be useful evidence of preparation while the actual migration remains unproven; an isolated pilot cannot establish organization-wide completion.
required_presentation_changes.replacement: NIST standards and the retained federal migration guidance make cryptographic change more concrete, but a standard does not replace cryptography in an operating system. The inherited OMB M-26-15 profile describes planning requirements for non-national-security federal systems, not an identical obligation for every system or institution. A named account still needs the actual cryptographic inventory, data-protection needs and supplier dependencies, followed by procurement, interoperability testing, cutover and retirement records tied to system versions. A plan demonstrates preparation, not completed migration; an isolated pilot cannot establish organization-wide completion. This assessment does not newly verify the memorandum, later amendments or agency compliance.

claim_findings.section_heading: Measure outcomes without rewarding incomplete visibility

required_presentation_changes.prior: A purchasing channel can make a product accessible to government buyers without demonstrating that any agency has ordered or successfully used it. GSA's AI purchasing material illustrates this distinction. Follow-up evidence would identify the buyer, order, scope, acceptance criteria and operating period. The GAO prototype-transition work offers another caution: its sampled findings and department-level tracking limitations should remain separate from the fate of an individual prototype.
